title: Hover Mode Toggle and Stabilization
description:
Purpose: Controlled hover for precise positioning with quick entry/exit and stabilization. Used for construct placement and mid-air combat.

Behaviour:
- Toggle entry: A (Right) double-tap toggles hover on/off. Distinguish double-tap with params.value("double_tap_ms", 350). If on ground and double-tap A, enter hover at current position with vertical lock and subtle bob.
- Movement while hovering:
  - Left Thumbstick: strafe/forward movement in chosen locomotion orientation (read from CLocomotionSettings.mode for head or controller relative vectors). Speed limited by params.value("hover_max_speed_mps", 2.0) with accel_tau_s and decel_tau_s similar to slide.
  - Right Thumbstick: turn (snap or smooth depending on settings). Optionally vertical adjust if params.value("right_stick_vertical", true): up/down on Right Stick Y changes altitude at params.value("altitude_rate_mps", 1.0) within clamps.
- Fine altitude adjust: Left Trigger held applies fine altitude step rate params.value("fine_altitude_rate_mps", 0.3).
- Quick brake: B (Right) tap sets velocity to zero and engages position-hold (damping factor increased) for params.value("brake_hold_s", 1.5).
- Auto-stabilization: when hover active, apply orientation stabilization to keep level (bank clamp params.value("bank_max_deg", 8.0)), and a slow bob sinusoid amplitude params.value("bob_amp_m", 0.02) for presence.
- Exit conditions: A (Right) double-tap or entering flight via flight_mode_mechanic will disable hover. On exit to ground, smoothly lerp to ground align and re-enable ground locomotion.
- Energy: Optional low drain from ring energy while hovering params.value("ring_drain_per_s", 0.5); if ring_energy < emergency threshold, allow emergency hover_hold for params.value("emergency_hold_s", 2.0) then auto-land.

Quest 3 bindings (params_json):
- params.value("toggle_button", "A_right")
- params.value("brake_button", "B_right")
- params.value("left_stick_move", true)
- params.value("left_trigger_fine_alt", true)

Components read/write:
- Reads CMechanicBinding, CTransform, CPhysics, CLocomotionSettings, CRingEnergy (from promoted.ring_charge_and_recharge), scene no-fly volumes via CTag{ "no_fly" }.
- Writes CHoverState{ active:bool, hold_timer:float }, CPhysics for velocity damping/orientation, and RingEnergy drain requests (API: ring_energy.consume_per_s).

Comfort/safety:
- Vignette intensity modest when speed > 1.0 m/s if enabled in settings.
- Disable entry in tight indoor no-fly volumes; show HUD tooltip.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_hover_toggle: Double-tap A enters hover; strafing with Left Thumbstick works; B quick press brakes to position hold; subtle stabilization observed.

Integration points:
- flight_mode_mechanic will call into this mechanic to engage hover on quick brake from flight.
- haptics_audio_feedback: fire small pulse on toggle and rhythmic low-level on hold.

Assets/scenes: training_arena, alien_city, asteroid_outpost, derelict_station, orbital_battlefield, fear_ruins, rescue_zone, oa_defense.
